role: Anvesha; read-only visual/editorial recommendation, no source or artwork-authenticity claims

actual_visual_samples.observation: Both completed columns leave a substantial open bottom area; a small centered tailpiece could add rhythm without displacing text.
Left column is dense; right gap is legitimate asymmetric flow. Do not place decoration beside the dense left explanation or suggest another entry image.
Both columns finish well above footer; a modest tailpiece fits, but a large second scene would compete with existing illustrations.

recommendation.maximum_frequency: One tailpiece per eligible reading page; never require one on every page. Alternate sparse motifs to avoid a repeated stamp.
recommendation.placement: Below the lower of the two complete column contents, centered within page body. Preserve footer and trim margins; never change text packing or scale existing entries to fit ornament.
recommendation.style: Fine black/sepia line art on white; small neutral leaf, curl or geometrical motif rather than another scene. No text, ritual insignia, human/caste figures or invented archaeological styling.
recommendation.provenance: Treat as newly made decorative editorial art; no labels such as authentic traditional border, archival ornament or historic Odia motif without evidence. Retain generated-art provenance in central credits/metadata; avoid per-motif source-like captions.
recommendation.scope: Reading pages only; no new ornament clutter over contents, cover or consolidated source credits.
